description: Figure 7 is a grouped bar chart that displays the number of questions, out of a total of 40, in which the Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generated by GPT3 using different methods contained at least one factual error. The horizontal axis categorizes the four datasets evaluated: HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC. For each dataset, three bars represent the performance of three methods: NoR QA (orange, solid fill), OneR QA (red, dotted fill), and IRCOT QA (blue, diagonal striped fill), as indicated by the legend. The vertical axis represents the count of questions with factual errors, ranging from 0 to 40. The chart shows that NoR QA consistently produces the highest number of factual errors across all datasets (15 on HotpotQA, 29 on 2WikiMQA, 28 on MuSiQue, and 15 on IIRC), followed by OneR QA (10, 23, 27, and 14 respectively), and IRCOT QA produces the fewest (5, 14, 23, and 11 respectively). The caption explicitly states the ranking of factual errors: IRCOT < OneR < NoR, which is visually confirmed by the decreasing bar heights from left to right within each group.
